scope: Opt-in protected32 native dispatcher; already decoded blocks only; no opcode or WASM grammar change
preCodeHypothesis: PR #88 profile attributed 1,196 runner position ticks to the setProgram call site (line 203) plus 655 direct setProgram self samples, 1,851 of 13,336 nonoverlapping positions (13.88%). V8 inlining means this is only an optimistic entry-cost envelope. Encode each decoded block once as 11-word-per-instruction Uint32Array and copy it on every admitted call with TypedArray.set, removing repeated JS object destructuring/scalar stores. Retain code-byte, data-window, page-table, privilege, event and fault validation unchanged.
priorNegativeContrast: The earlier program-transfer cache skipped setProgram only while the same block remained loaded and measured just 0.8% over two pairs. This candidate still copies every entry, including block switches, but changes per-entry marshaling from JS object/scalar loops to a cached typed-array bulk copy.
cacheContract: Decoded IR and its packedProgram are internal immutable cache data. The native runner's run() callers must not mutate block.instructions, its instruction objects, or packedProgram after decode/packing; guest self-modifying or DMA code writes change RAM and are still rejected by the existing byte/window validation before any packed program copy. A changed guest block must be decoded again.

host.cpu: Intel Xeon Processor (Skylake, IBRS, no TSX), KVM, 4 vCPU
host.note: Shared VPS load fluctuated; paired user CPU, not elapsed time, is the retention measure.

workload.name: lean stock xv6-public forktest, 4 MiB, Bochs BIOS
workload.env: XV6_LEAN=1 XV6_RAM_HASH=1 XV6_NATIVE_DISPATCH=1 XV6_FIRMWARE=bochs XV6_STEPS=40000000 XV6_STOP_ON_EXPECT=1 XV6_COMMAND=$'forktest\r' XV6_EXPECT_SERIAL=$'fork test OK\n$ ' XV6_ROM=/tmp/bw386-cheapentry-20260928/roms/free-at-bios/BIOS-bochs-legacy

gate.predeclared: At least 5% lower mean unprofiled user CPU across three serial adjacent baseline/candidate full xv6 pairs, every pair favorable, byte-identical complete guest/RAM reports, focused safety tests.
gate.result: pass; retain candidate for audit, no merge yet

validation.focusedTests: 48/48 pass: block-spike, native-byte-block, native-dispatch and write-window tests, including code edit, page remap, A20/permission, IRQ/NMI/PIC/IOAPIC and chip horizon; new packed-vs-scalar event-exit/state equality test.
validation.sourceGuards: Block validity, byte comparison, read/write windows, code-page/page-table exclusions, precise fallback and chip/LAPIC/PIC/IOAPIC/NMI gates are unchanged. Only IR transfer after successful admission changes.

limits: This is an opt-in 32-bit native path improvement on one xv6 workload and one VPS. It is not an overall 80386/Windows 10x result. Full guest report parity proves the measured run, not all possible protected32 programs.
